name: TheoryLab
purpose: AI-readable executable theory graphs with evidence receipts, Genealogy-grounded proposal generation, proposal-to-experiment promotion, online coordinate-continuation gates, and replayable discovery history

runtime.propose: python -m theorylab propose "Can useful computational coordinates self-align with persistent write?" --json
runtime.propose_tracking: python -m theorylab propose "Can a local online learner preserve useful computational identity when the resident coordinate system itself drifts?" --json

extension.node_contract: Every executable node declares semantic role, typed ports, parameters, executor and provenance.
extension.knowledge_contract: Imported historical mechanisms are curated as the smallest reusable object plus survived claim and boundary; they are not assumed executable.
extension.proposal_contract: A proposal must expose grounding, selected components, selected constraints, candidate graph, attackers, gates, and any missing executors.
extension.theory_contract: Every executable theory declares question, hypothesis, assumptions, node instances, edges, experiments, measurements, attackers and gates.
extension.evidence_contract: Every run may emit a receipt without mutating the theory definition.
extension.history_contract: Every discovery attempt can point to a parent attempt so alternative exploration policies can replay the realized tree.
extension.promotion_contract: A proposal may become executable only when every declared missing executor has a concrete node/runtime contract; the promoted theory must validate and run before any claim is supported.
